source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Typed school paper with a real text layer (checked against the rendered pages). No year is printed; examYear 2021 is taken from the file name (...-230922-2021) and the icseboard.org folder. MM: 45 and Time: 3 Hours are printed, but no marks are printed for any question or group, so every item is recorded with marks 0 (unknown) and flagged. Numbering restarts in each group I-VIII, so the group numeral is stored as the question number and the item number as the part; the group instruction as printed is joined in front of short items. Stray text printed inside IV.1, IV.3 and IV.5 (apparently OCR residue of handwriting baked into the original file) is left out and flagged. The class 6 chapter list has no percentage chapter; percentage items are mapped to ratio-and-proportion. The WhatsApp/Paytm advertisement at the end and the icseboard.org watermark are ignored.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
